title: The Honorary Psychology Role: 7 reasons it sparks debates

sentences.en: What if your professional expertise could earn you money even when you're not working?
sentences.zh: 如果你的专业知识即使在你没工作的时候也能为你赚钱，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and since 2019 I've been building additional income streams
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在建立额外的收入来源，

sentences.en: through books, online courses and memberships, and it's made such a difference to my business and my life.
sentences.zh: 通过书籍、在线课程和会员制，这给我的事业和生活带来了巨大的改变。

sentences.en: Tonight at 7pm, Sophie Foote is hosting a free Make Money Online Masterclass, exploring how you can turn your existing skills and knowledge into additional income streaMs.
sentences.zh: 今晚 7 点，Sophie Foote 将举办一场免费的“在线赚钱大师班”，探讨如何将你现有的技能和知识转化为额外的收入来源。

sentences.en: And I'd love more psychologists and mental health professionals to join us.
sentences.zh: 我非常希望更多的心理学家和心理健康专业人士能加入我们。

sentences.en: I'll be there too, supporting a lovely community of fellow psychologists, exploring what's possible beyond one-to-one work.
sentences.zh: 我也会参加，支持一个由心理学家同行组成的可爱社区，探索一对一工作之外的可能性。

sentences.en: Replays are available if you can't join live.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法参加直播，可以观看回放。

sentences.en: Click the link with this pre-roll or reach out to me on socials to grab your free place, because you can serve others and deserve financial freedom too.
sentences.zh: 点击此预告片中的链接，或在社交媒体上联系我获取免费名额，因为你既可以服务他人，也理应获得财务自由。

sentences.en: Unpaid, yet seemingly essential.
sentences.zh: 无薪，却看似必不可少。

sentences.en: Controversial, yet coveted.
sentences.zh: 充满争议，却又令人趋之若鹜。

sentences.en: Picture this, aspiring psychologist navigating a landscape where experience often comes at the detriment of actual compensation.
sentences.zh: 试想一下，有抱负的心理学家在这样一个环境中摸索：经验往往是以牺牲实际报酬为代价的。

sentences.en: But why the buzz around honoree assistant psychologist roles?
sentences.zh: 但为什么关于“荣誉助理心理学家”职位的讨论如此热烈？

sentences.en: What secrets do they hold?
sentences.zh: 它们隐藏着什么秘密？

sentences.en: Why are they so unethical?
sentences.zh: 为什么它们如此不道德？

sentences.en: Join me for today's episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast, where we unravel the enigma surrounding these positions and delve right into the heart of the debate.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听今天的《有抱负的心理学家》播客，我们将揭开这些职位的谜团，直击辩论的核心。

sentences.en: Stay tuned and I hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I am a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Now, recently on my LinkedIn and on my Instagram, I am Dr. Marianne Trent in both of those places, where I said, what gives me the ick?
sentences.zh: 最近在我的 LinkedIn 和 Instagram 上（在这两个平台上我都是 Marianne Trent 博士），我提出了一个问题：什么让我感到反感？

sentences.en: And the answer was advertising of honoree assistant psychologist posts.
sentences.zh: 答案是：招聘“荣誉助理心理学家”职位的广告。

sentences.en: And it's true, it does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，它确实让我反感。

sentences.en: It feels a bit yuck.
sentences.zh: 感觉有点恶心。

sentences.en: Before we dive into this episode where we're exploring the seven reasons why honoree assistant positions are controversial,
sentences.zh: 在我们深入探讨本期节目，分析荣誉助理职位为何充满争议的七个原因之前，

sentences.en: let me quickly take you through a little bit of definition about what I mean.
sentences.zh: 让我先快速为你解释一下我所指的定义。

sentences.en: So typically an honoree assistant psychologist position would be one where somebody might be working in a hospital or a clinic or a research setting,
sentences.zh: 通常，荣誉助理心理学家的职位是指某人在医院、诊所或研究机构工作，

sentences.en: usually supporting qualified psychologists to deliver a service that they provide.
sentences.zh: 通常是协助合格的心理学家提供他们所提供的服务。

sentences.en: The roles of an honoree assistant psychologist might be conducting assessments, supporting with admin tasks,
sentences.zh: 荣誉助理心理学家的职责可能包括进行评估、协助行政任务、

sentences.en: scoring assessments, starting to make a start on writing letters, maybe collecting data,
sentences.zh: 评分评估、开始尝试写信，或许还有收集数据，

sentences.en: sometimes even administering interventions like therapy groups alongside, hopefully, qualified staff.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至是在合格员工的指导下，协助实施治疗小组等干预措施。

sentences.en: But unlike formal assistant psychologist roles, these roles are unpaid.
sentences.zh: 但与正式的助理心理学家职位不同，这些职位是没有报酬的。

sentences.en: So what we're not talking about necessarily here is a separate debate.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这里讨论的未必是另一个话题。

sentences.en: We're not talking about placement student roles.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的不是实习生职位。

sentences.en: We're not talking about master's placement roles.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的不是硕士实习职位。

sentences.en: We're not talking about undergraduate sandwich year placement roles, which can be quite common.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的不是本科生三明治课程实习职位，这些职位很常见。

sentences.en: And I understand that they are not paid.
sentences.zh: 我理解这些职位是没有报酬的。

sentences.en: But for me, this issue is when you see a company advertising honoree assistant psychologist roles.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，这个问题在于当你看到一家公司在招聘荣誉助理心理学家时。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's a whole different debate.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是完全不同的辩论。

sentences.en: The unpaid placement, which helps you then get your qualification that you are obviously paying and wanting to develop.
sentences.zh: 无薪实习有助于你获得你显然正在付费并希望发展的资格认证。

sentences.en: But that is not really the main topic of this podcast, although very important debates too.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是本期播客的主要话题，尽管这也是非常重要的辩论。

sentences.en: What we're talking about is people asking for people to come into their service and work for free doing highly skilled work.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的是人们要求他人进入他们的服务机构，免费从事高技能工作。

sentences.en: That's what we are discussing today.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天要讨论的内容。

sentences.en: So with no further ado, let's look at reason one why this is a controversial hot potato.
sentences.zh: 那么，废话少说，让我们来看看为什么这是一个充满争议的“烫手山芋”的第一个原因。

sentences.en: Well, it may not surprise you that I'm leading with this first reason, and that is exploitation of labour.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我提出第一个原因你可能不会感到惊讶，那就是对劳动力的剥削。

sentences.en: You might well see this in NHS settings, and I'm starting to see it crop up in private practice as well.
sentences.zh: 你很可能会在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的环境中看到这种情况，而且我开始看到它也出现在私人诊所中。

sentences.en: You know, some people feel fiercely protective of the fact that this happens in NHS services, but it still isn't OK.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些人极力维护这种现象在 NHS 服务中存在的事实，但这仍然是不对的。

sentences.en: Asking people to come and work for you for free, to travel to and from your work base, to buy their own lunch, to, you know, often to pay their own parking, it's not all right.
sentences.zh: 要求人们免费为你工作，往返于工作地点，自己买午餐，你知道，通常还要自己付停车费，这不对。

sentences.en: It's not all right to the person doing that role.
sentences.zh: 这对担任该角色的人来说是不对的。

sentences.en: It's not all right to the people who cannot afford to do that role.
sentences.zh: 对于那些负担不起担任该角色的人来说，这也是不对的。

sentences.en: Some people might say it's only a day or two a week.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会说，这只是每周一天或两天。

sentences.en: It's fine.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: It's like, well, it's not fine, because that's actually a big chunk.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，这并不好，因为这实际上占了很大一部分。

sentences.en: That's 20 or 40% of what could be their full-time equivalent salary.
sentences.zh: 这相当于他们全职等效工资的 20% 或 40%。

sentences.en: And I'm concerned that it creates the context where free labour is part of the service that's built in.
sentences.zh: 我担心这创造了一种环境，即免费劳动力成为服务的一部分。

sentences.en: We're, you know, allowing staffing needs to partly come from free labour.
sentences.zh: 我们，你知道，允许人员需求部分来自免费劳动力。

sentences.en: And that's not OK.
sentences.zh: 这不对。

sentences.en: That's not OK, because this is important work that we're asking people to do.
sentences.zh: 这不对，因为我们要求人们做的是重要的工作。

sentences.en: It's exploitative.
sentences.zh: 这是剥削性的。

sentences.en: And my realic is when you see it in private practice, where people are actually charging money.
sentences.zh: 当我看到私人诊所里出现这种情况时，我真的很反感，因为他们实际上是在收费。

sentences.en: It's allowing the qualified psychologists to earn more money because they're not having to pay a virtual assistant or they're not having to do the role themselves.
sentences.zh: 这让合格的心理学家赚了更多的钱，因为他们不必支付虚拟助理的费用，也不必自己做这项工作。

sentences.en: It's not OK.
sentences.zh: 这不对。

sentences.en: It's stinky.
sentences.zh: 这很糟糕。

sentences.en: I'm not all right with it.
sentences.zh: 我无法接受。

sentences.en: And, of course, what we know in certainly NHS organisations is that we still need our honoree or voluntary staff to be trained.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们知道在 NHS 机构中，我们仍然需要培训我们的荣誉或志愿人员。

sentences.en: And so you get the position of inequity where you might well be sat next to a Band 9, Band 8D, Band, you know, whatever psychologist
sentences.zh: 所以你会陷入一种不平等的境地，你可能坐在一位 9 级、8D 级，你知道，无论什么级别的心理学家旁边，

sentences.en: who is perhaps new to the trust as well, doing their mandatory training and knowing that they're getting paid, you know, quite a nice wedge of money
sentences.zh: 他们可能也是刚加入信托基金，正在进行强制性培训，并且知道他们拿着相当不错的薪水，

sentences.en: and you are getting paid zero and gone are the days where you often get free lunch.
sentences.zh: 而你却一分钱也拿不到，而且通常提供免费午餐的日子也一去不复返了。

sentences.en: So there's not even the perk there.
sentences.zh: 所以甚至连那点福利都没有了。

sentences.en: Massively exploitative.
sentences.zh: 这是极大的剥削。

sentences.en: So point number two is inequitable access.
sentences.zh: 所以第二点是不平等的准入。

sentences.en: This is creating gaps for those who can or can't afford to pursue their career in psychology.
sentences.zh: 这为那些负担得起或负担不起心理学职业发展的人制造了差距。

sentences.en: So, of course, those who can afford to work in an honoree capacity might be likely to be younger.
sentences.zh: 当然，那些负担得起以荣誉身份工作的人可能更年轻。

sentences.en: And I know that actually a big chunk of my podcast listeners are actually a little bit older.
sentences.zh: 我知道实际上我很大一部分播客听众其实年龄稍大一些。

sentences.en: So some of my most popular episodes, certainly on YouTube, have been those that feature older applicants.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的一些最受欢迎的剧集，尤其是在 YouTube 上，都是那些以年长申请人为特色的剧集。

sentences.en: So I know this matters.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道这很重要。

sentences.en: I know this is important.
sentences.zh: 我知道这很重要。

sentences.en: And what we know is that, of course, these honoree assistant roles do actually help people's career.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，这些荣誉助理职位确实有助于人们的职业生涯。

sentences.en: If we're only allowing people to get a bump start, if they can afford to work for free, that means we're discounting people who are parents.
sentences.zh: 如果我们只允许那些负担得起免费工作的人获得起步机会，那就意味着我们排除了那些为人父母的人。

sentences.en: We're discounting people who don't have maybe parents to let them live with them for free or to take reduced rent.
sentences.zh: 我们排除了那些可能没有父母让他们免费同住或减免房租的人。

sentences.en: We know we're discounting so many different types of people.
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们排除了太多不同类型的人。

sentences.en: And we're giving the red carpet treatment with the gold spangled banners to people who can afford to work for free.
sentences.zh: 我们为那些负担得起免费工作的人铺上了红地毯，挂上了金色的旗帜。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's just that inequitable access.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这就是不平等的准入。

sentences.en: It's the platform not being level for all that makes this so unjuSt.
sentences.zh: 正是因为平台对所有人来说都不公平，才使得这一切如此不公正。

sentences.en: Point number three is access to supervision and professional development.
sentences.zh: 第三点是获得督导和专业发展的机会。

sentences.en: Now, as an honoree member of staff, you're not always really counted in the numbers.
sentences.zh: 作为一名荣誉员工，你并不总是被计入人数中。

sentences.en: People often don't even really know your name.
sentences.zh: 人们通常甚至不知道你的名字。

sentences.en: They might well talk about you behind your back as the honoree.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能会在背后把你称为“那个荣誉员工”。

sentences.en: You're seen as more transient and you might not regularly have access to supervision.
sentences.zh: 你被视为更具流动性，而且你可能无法定期获得督导。

sentences.en: You may feel like you're having to chase people for supervision because probably there's not really the job plan hours of time to be able to supervise you.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得你必须追着别人寻求督导，因为可能根本没有工作计划中的时间来督导你。

sentences.en: Because this is probably something that's been thought of as a stop gap to plug, plug gaps in the service, not necessarily something that's been thought about in any great detail.
sentences.zh: 因为这可能被认为是一种填补服务空缺的临时措施，而不一定经过深思熟虑。

sentences.en: And it's often thought about to plug gaps in the service rather than to further your own development and think about how well contained and supported you feel.
sentences.zh: 而且它通常被认为是用来填补服务空缺，而不是为了促进你自己的发展，或者考虑你感到被支持和包容的程度。

sentences.en: One AP who listens to the podcast told me that they had left an honorary assistant psychologist position because they felt the management was really horrendous.
sentences.zh: 一位收听播客的助理心理学家告诉我，他们离开了一个荣誉助理心理学家的职位，因为他们觉得管理层真的很糟糕。

sentences.en: And that it meant that somebody who condoned this level of honoree role, went out of their way to recruit and appoint to it, was less likely to rally for change, you know,
sentences.zh: 这意味着纵容这种荣誉职位的人，费尽心思去招聘和任命它，不太可能为变革而奔走，你知道，

sentences.en: and to think that that job was worthwhile and that that person deserved to be paid for doing that role.
sentences.zh: 也不太可能认为这份工作是有价值的，或者那个人理应为这份工作获得报酬。

sentences.en: So there's something around the services and the supervisors who are condoning these honorary assistant psychologist roles.
sentences.zh: 所以，关于那些纵容这些荣誉助理心理学家职位的服务机构和督导，确实存在一些问题。

sentences.en: Without that proper supervision, without, you know, appraisals, you're not necessarily going to develop in the same way as you would as if you were in that paid capacity.
sentences.zh: 没有适当的督导，没有评估，你未必能像在有薪职位那样获得同样的发展。

sentences.en: Perhaps you're not getting access to the training courses that would help further your development, but that your paid counterparts might well be getting access to.
sentences.zh: 也许你无法获得有助于促进你发展的培训课程，而你的有薪同行却可能获得这些机会。

sentences.en: And, of course, what we know is that not all honorary roles are classed or counted in the same way as paid roles by people screening applications.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们知道，筛选申请的人并不总是将所有荣誉职位与有薪职位同等看待或计算。

sentences.en: And, of course, if you're not doing that honorary role full time, it can take really quite some time to score the adequate days, months,
sentences.zh: 而且，当然，如果你不是全职从事该荣誉职位，可能真的需要很长时间才能积累足够的日子、月份、

sentences.en: years to be able to get what looks reasonable on your CV.
sentences.zh: 年份，才能让你的简历看起来合理。

sentences.en: So, yeah, just to summarise on point three, it's just that you are not feeling like you're being treated the same as other people.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，总结一下第三点，就是你感觉自己没有受到与其他人同样的对待。

sentences.en: You're not being afforded the same time for supervision.
sentences.zh: 你没有获得同样的督导时间。

sentences.en: You're not being afforded the same time for development.
sentences.zh: 你没有获得同样的发展时间。

sentences.en: And that could hinder you.
sentences.zh: 这可能会阻碍你。

sentences.en: That could hold you back.
sentences.zh: 这可能会拖你的后腿。

sentences.en: Point number four will be coming up after this short break.
sentences.zh: 第四点将在短暂休息后回来讨论。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: So, in the first half of our episode, we were looking at the first three reasons why honorary assistant psychologist posts can be so controversial.
sentences.zh: 在节目的前半部分，我们探讨了荣誉助理心理学家职位为何如此充满争议的前三个原因。

sentences.en: Dive back in and have a little look at point number four.
sentences.zh: 让我们深入探讨第四点。

sentences.en: So, point number four is that this normalisation,
sentences.zh: 第四点是这种正常化，

sentences.en: this seeing honorary assistant psychologist posts being advertised and kind of continuing and perpetuating the treadmill of honorary assistant psychologist being present in services means that we become acquiesced to that.
sentences.zh: 看到荣誉助理心理学家职位的广告，并以某种方式持续和延续这种荣誉助理心理学家在服务中存在的“跑步机”，意味着我们对此变得默许。

sentences.en: That we're perhaps more likely to just accept it and not fight for change and not fight for these positions to become paid.
sentences.zh: 我们可能更容易接受它，而不去为变革而战，不去为这些职位争取报酬而战。

sentences.en: You know, if we're continuing to deliver the services, of course, public services are very important.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我们继续提供这些服务，当然，公共服务非常重要。

sentences.en: I'm not saying they're not.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说它们不重要。

sentences.en: But people and human development is also really, really important.
sentences.zh: 但人的发展也非常、非常重要。

sentences.en: And some people are saying, well, we can't run this service without honorary assistants.
sentences.zh: 有些人说，没有荣誉助理，我们就无法运营这项服务。

sentences.en: Maybe we need to start voting with our feet and saying no to supervising honorary assistant psychologists and saying no to delivering interventions with people who don't have the privilege of being paid.
sentences.zh: 也许我们需要开始用行动投票，拒绝督导荣誉助理心理学家，拒绝与那些没有获得报酬特权的人一起提供干预措施。

sentences.en: You know, it's just a basic right, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这只是一个基本权利，不是吗？

sentences.en: You do a job, you do a day's work, you get paid for it.
sentences.zh: 你做一份工作，你做了一天的工作，你就应该为此获得报酬。

sentences.en: So, the more and more we see these posts advertised, the more and more they will continue to happen.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们看到的这类广告越多，它们就会持续发生得越多。

sentences.en: And so, perhaps we need to buck the trend of this normalisation.
sentences.zh: 因此，也许我们需要打破这种正常化的趋势。

sentences.en: Start putting boundaries in place and start saying no.
sentences.zh: 开始设定界限，开始说不。

sentences.en: So, point five is the ethical considerations.
sentences.zh: 第五点是道德考量。

sentences.en: There's ethical considerations around for honorary assistant psychologists as well.
sentences.zh: 荣誉助理心理学家也存在道德考量。

sentences.en: So, if they're working in private practice, do they have their own indemnity insurance?
sentences.zh: 如果他们在私人诊所工作，他们有自己的赔偿保险吗？

sentences.en: How are they coping with any moral or ethical dilemmas that might crop up?
sentences.zh: 他们如何应对可能出现的任何道德或伦理困境？

sentences.en: You know, things like confidentiality, boundaries, you know, tricky questions that you might get asked by clients.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比如保密性、界限，你知道，客户可能会问你的棘手问题。

sentences.en: Do they have the necessary training, skills, expertise, supervision to be able to do justice to that role and to the service that they're representing?
sentences.zh: 他们是否具备必要的培训、技能、专业知识和督导，以公正地对待该角色和他们所代表的服务？

sentences.en: And do they have the relevant number of hours supervision with somebody who's looking after them and looking out for them?
sentences.zh: 他们是否与照顾他们、关心他们的人有足够的时间进行督导？

sentences.en: I think that's a really important consideration.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个非常重要的考量。

sentences.en: Are they seen as a person or are they just seen as someone to help support the service?
sentences.zh: 他们是被视为一个人，还是仅仅被视为帮助支持服务的人？

sentences.en: Are they getting invited to team lunches?
sentences.zh: 他们会被邀请参加团队午餐吗？

sentences.en: Are they getting to spend time shadowing other members of the team, not just doing the role you want them to do?
sentences.zh: 他们有机会花时间跟随团队的其他成员，而不仅仅是做你想让他们做的工作吗？

sentences.en: It's an ethical and moral minefield.
sentences.zh: 这是一个道德和伦理的雷区。

sentences.en: So, point number six is the impact upon diversity and upon the profession.
sentences.zh: 第六点是对多样性和专业的影响。

sentences.en: When we advertise honorary assistant psychologist roles, we are often advertising for people who are already psychology graduates,
sentences.zh: 当我们招聘荣誉助理心理学家职位时，我们通常是在招聘已经是心理学毕业生的人，

sentences.en: who would technically be capable of fulfilling perhaps a band four, a band five NHS paid assistant role.
sentences.zh: 他们从技术上讲有能力胜任 NHS 的 4 级或 5 级有薪助理职位。

sentences.en: And we're asking these people to work for free.
sentences.zh: 而我们却要求这些人免费工作。

sentences.en: Often there is the essential criteria and the person spec requirements of, you know, basically the same as a paid role.
sentences.zh: 通常，基本标准和个人规格要求与有薪职位基本相同。

sentences.en: But we're saying, could you maybe just do that for free?
sentences.zh: 但我们却说，你能不能免费做这件事？

sentences.en: If you do work in the NHS or you have experience of working in the NHS,
sentences.zh: 如果你在 NHS 工作，或者你有在 NHS 工作的经验，

sentences.en: if you consider for a moment the admin teams and often the complexity of work that you're asking admin staff to do will be meted out to them by their supervisors based on the qualifications and the expertise level of that person.
sentences.zh: 如果你考虑一下行政团队，通常你要求行政人员做的工作的复杂程度，将由他们的督导根据该人的资格和专业水平来分配。

sentences.en: Now, if you think about the work that might be done for you by a band four or band five admin member of staff,
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你想想 4 级或 5 级行政人员可能为你做的工作，

sentences.en: what I'm sure we won't find is people doing honorary band four or band five admin roles.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们不会发现有人在做荣誉 4 级或 5 级行政职位。

sentences.en: Because they are seen as highly skilled and experienced admin work.
sentences.zh: 因为他们被视为高技能和经验丰富的行政工作。

sentences.en: And yet the same does not seem to be true for highly skilled and experienced qualified psychology graduates.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于高技能和经验丰富的合格心理学毕业生来说，情况似乎并非如此。

sentences.en: We're asking for the same person spec, the same job description as if they were being paid, but of course they're not.
sentences.zh: 我们要求同样的个人规格、同样的职位描述，就好像他们是有报酬的一样，但当然他们没有。

sentences.en: This is something I was chatting about with Gavin Clark, who's joined us for two recent podcast episodes,
sentences.zh: 这是我和 Gavin Clark 聊天时谈到的，他最近参加了我们的两期播客节目，

sentences.en: one on distance learning masters and one on navigating psychology from a wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 一期是关于远程学习硕士，另一期是关于坐轮椅探索心理学。

sentences.en: He was sharing with me that in the legal profession, honorary roles are really, really common.
sentences.zh: 他和我分享说，在法律行业，荣誉职位非常、非常普遍。

sentences.en: And it seems that psychology are learning from that, but it's not OK.
sentences.zh: 心理学界似乎正在向他们学习，但这不对。

sentences.en: And I feel like in the legal profession, people should know more about morals and ethics.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在法律行业，人们应该对道德和伦理有更多的了解。

sentences.en: And we don't want to be continuing and perpetuating this narrative that it's acceptable for psychology graduates to work for free.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望继续助长这种观念，即心理学毕业生免费工作是可以接受的。

sentences.en: It's not OK.
sentences.zh: 这不对。

sentences.en: We need to start taking control, saying no.
sentences.zh: 我们需要开始掌控局面，学会说不。

sentences.en: We need to stop advertising these roles.
sentences.zh: 我们需要停止发布这些职位的招聘广告。

sentences.en: So in terms of the impact on the profession, we're undervaluing the role that these honorary assistant psychologist personnel are doing for the service.
sentences.zh: 因此，就对行业的影响而言，我们低估了这些荣誉助理心理学家为服务机构所做的贡献。

sentences.en: And we shouldn't be.
sentences.zh: 我们本不该如此。

sentences.en: Again, if we look at the kind of inequity of this situation, we look at how the diversity of the profession is being impacted upon.
sentences.zh: 同样，如果我们审视这种情况下的不平等，就会发现它对行业多样性造成了怎样的影响。

sentences.en: It might well be only certain demographics who can afford to do these roles.
sentences.zh: 很可能只有特定背景的人才负担得起这些职位。

sentences.en: And so we're perpetuating perhaps the white, middle class, young aspect of psychology.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们可能在延续心理学界白人、中产阶级和年轻化的现状。

sentences.en: Point number seven is self-belief.
sentences.zh: 第七点是自信。

sentences.en: So if someone has only ever been paid zero pounds and zero pennies for their work and not had adequate supervision and felt like they had to chase for containment and support,
sentences.zh: 如果一个人在工作中从未获得过任何报酬，没有得到充分的督导，并且感觉自己必须不断寻求支持和保障，

sentences.en: they may well actually be going into interviews for paid roles,
sentences.zh: 那么当他们去参加带薪职位的面试时，

sentences.en: feeling that they're not quite good enough or that they haven't had the time spent enriching them that they deserved.
sentences.zh: 可能会觉得自己不够优秀，或者没有得到应有的培养和提升。

sentences.en: They may feel less experienced or less able or capable than people who have been in paid roles compared to them.
sentences.zh: 与那些担任过带薪职位的人相比，他们可能会感到自己经验不足或能力较弱。

sentences.en: So this could really knock them.
sentences.zh: 这真的会打击到他们。

sentences.en: It could really impact on them and their self-belief.
sentences.zh: 这可能会对他们及其自信心产生严重影响。

sentences.en: And that's our final point.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的最后一点。

sentences.en: That's our point seven.
sentences.zh: 也就是第七点。

sentences.en: If they go into these honorary assistant roles thinking that it will further their career, but actually knocks their confidence,
sentences.zh: 如果他们抱着能促进职业发展的想法去担任这些荣誉助理职位，结果却打击了自信心，

sentences.en: that could then hinder their professional growth and development.
sentences.zh: 那反而会阻碍他们的职业成长和发展。

sentences.en: So to summarise, these honorary assistant roles are a little bit different than placement roles, which are usually sourced and supported by universities.
sentences.zh: 总结一下，这些荣誉助理职位与通常由大学提供和支持的实习职位略有不同。

sentences.en: We've been talking today about services that are advertising, purposefully recruiting to honorary assistant roles.
sentences.zh: 我们今天讨论的是那些专门发布广告、有目的地招募荣誉助理职位的服务机构。

sentences.en: We need to think more about the person.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更多地为个人着想。

sentences.en: We need to think more about the equity.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更多地考虑公平性。

sentences.en: We need to think more about what we might be able to do to rally the change, to stop this happening.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更多地思考能做些什么来推动变革，阻止这种情况发生。

sentences.en: We need to think more about this and the impact it has upon people, upon teams, upon services and upon the career and professional development as a whole.
sentences.zh: 我们需要深入思考这个问题，以及它对个人、团队、服务机构以及整体职业发展所产生的影响。

sentences.en: We need to stop exploiting people in our profession.
sentences.zh: 我们需要停止在行业内剥削他人。

sentences.en: And I know it's difficult if you are looking to get your foot on the rung of the ladder for your next career move in psychology.
sentences.zh: 我知道，如果你正试图在心理学职业生涯中迈出第一步，这会很困难。

sentences.en: But perhaps we need to call upon you to stop applying for these roles.
sentences.zh: 但也许我们需要呼吁大家停止申请这些职位。

sentences.en: Because, you know, I created a role for myself as an honorary assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我也曾为自己创造过一个荣誉助理心理学家的职位。

sentences.en: You know, I've been quite open about that in my book, The Clinical Psychologist Collective, and in the podcast in the past previously, too.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在我的书《临床心理学家集体》以及之前的播客中对此都非常坦诚。

sentences.en: It did help me.
sentences.zh: 它确实帮助了我。

sentences.en: It helped me to get to grips with psychology terMs.
sentences.zh: 它帮助我掌握了心理学术语。

sentences.en: It helped me to get a feel for what I should and what I could be saying and thinking and doing.
sentences.zh: 它让我对应该说什么、想什么、做什么有了一些感觉。

sentences.en: It helped me be able to say, I'd done this.
sentences.zh: 它让我能够说，我做过这些。

sentences.en: I'd done that.
sentences.zh: 我做过那些。

sentences.en: But it helped me more than it helped the service, I would say, in that example.
sentences.zh: 但在那个例子中，我认为它对我的帮助比对服务机构的帮助更大。

sentences.en: And this still wasn't OK, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且这依然是不对的，你知道的。

sentences.en: It did help me to get my first paid role, which wasn't in that service.
sentences.zh: 它确实帮助我获得了第一份带薪工作，虽然不是在那个服务机构。

sentences.en: It was in a completely different service and a completely different organisation.
sentences.zh: 那是在一个完全不同的服务机构和完全不同的组织。

sentences.en: I'm not saying they're not helpful, but I'm saying it's not ethical.
sentences.zh: 我不是说它们毫无用处，我是说这不符合道德。

sentences.en: I'm saying it's not fair.
sentences.zh: 我是说这不公平。

sentences.en: It's not right.
sentences.zh: 这不对。

sentences.en: And as we do learn and grow and develop in our career, we can make different choices than those which we've made in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 随着我们在职业生涯中不断学习、成长和发展，我们可以做出与过去不同的选择。

sentences.en: People contact me all the time, you know, several times a week to say, Marianne, is there anything I can do for you?
sentences.zh: 人们总是联系我，每周好几次，问我：玛丽安，有什么我能为你做的吗？

sentences.en: Can I do some honorary assistant work?
sentences.zh: 我可以做一些荣誉助理工作吗？

sentences.en: Can I come and do a placement with you?
sentences.zh: 我可以来你这里实习吗？

sentences.en: And I say no, because I don't think it's fair to them.
sentences.zh: 我拒绝了，因为我觉得这对他们不公平。

sentences.en: I haven't yet got a predictable way of being able to help make someone's experience useful to them,
sentences.zh: 我还没有找到一种可预测的方式，既能让别人的经验对他们有用，

sentences.en: but also useful to me in a way that it can help me to increase my revenue to then be able to pay them.
sentences.zh: 又能对我有用，从而增加我的收入，进而能够支付他们的报酬。

sentences.en: And I'm not willing to have people work for me for free.
sentences.zh: 我不愿意让人免费为我工作。

sentences.en: I don't think that's how it should work.
sentences.zh: 我不认为事情该是这样的。

sentences.en: I'm in the business of building up aspiring psychologists, of equipping them with all of the resources they're going to need to hopefully live a really prosperous,
sentences.zh: 我的事业是培养有抱负的心理学家，为他们提供所需的资源，希望他们能过上真正繁荣、

sentences.en: enjoyable career as a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 令人愉快的心理学家职业生涯。

sentences.en: I don't want to be ill equipping or stripping away what they think about themselves or their capabilities or their abilities.
sentences.zh: 我不想让他们能力不足，也不想打击他们对自身能力或潜力的认知。

sentences.en: And if I'm going to make money out of something that somebody has done, or if it's going to help me to deliver a service that then means I can charge money,
sentences.zh: 如果我打算从某人的劳动中获利，或者如果这能帮助我提供服务并据此收费，

sentences.en: I think that that ought to be being passed on to the people that are supporting that role as well.
sentences.zh: 我认为这些收益也应该分给那些支持该职位的人。

sentences.en: I think everybody working in an assistant psychologist capacity, supporting and enabling qualified psychologists to do their job more efficiently, more effectively.
sentences.zh: 我认为每一位担任助理心理学家的人，都在支持和协助合格的心理学家更高效、更有效地完成工作。

sentences.en: And in services where money is being exchanged, I believe people should be paid.
sentences.zh: 在有金钱往来的服务机构中，我认为人们应该获得报酬。

sentences.en: But also even in services such as the NHS, where they are free at the point of delivery, there is still money involved.
sentences.zh: 即使是在像英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）这样提供免费服务的机构，依然涉及资金运作。

sentences.en: This is still essentially supposed to be a profitable business.
sentences.zh: 这本质上仍被视为一种盈利性业务。

sentences.en: So staffing costs and looking at commissioning of the services.
sentences.zh: 所以涉及人员成本和对服务采购的考量。

sentences.en: What are we commissioning for?
sentences.zh: 我们采购的目的是什么？

sentences.en: Are we asking for adequate staffing to run our therapy groups, to be able to do our assessments, to be able to support the admin roles surrounding paid psychologists?
sentences.zh: 我们是否要求配备足够的人员来开展治疗小组、进行评估，并支持带薪心理学家周围的行政工作？

sentences.en: This is such a big and important discussion.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重大且重要的讨论。

sentences.en: I would love your thoughts on this.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听你们对此的想法。

sentences.en: Please do come along.
sentences.zh: 请一定要参与进来。

sentences.en: Follow me on socials.
sentences.zh: 在社交媒体上关注我。

sentences.en: Connect with me.
sentences.zh: 与我建立联系。

sentences.en: Get involved with the posts that I mentioned on Instagram and on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 参与我在Instagram和LinkedIn上提到的帖子讨论。

sentences.en: Please do come along to the Aspiring Psychologist Community free Facebook group.
sentences.zh: 请一定要加入“有抱负的心理学家社区”免费Facebook群组。

sentences.en: Let me know what you think to this.
sentences.zh: 让我知道你对此的看法。

sentences.en: If you're watching on YouTube, please do subscribe.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在YouTube上观看，请务必订阅。

sentences.en: Please do like.
sentences.zh: 请务必点赞。

sentences.en: Engage with the content.
sentences.zh: 与内容互动。

sentences.en: Let me know what you would like more of from me.
sentences.zh: 让我知道你还想从我这里获得什么内容。

sentences.en: And if you find the things I talk about useful, please do consider checking out the Clinical Psychologist Collective book, the Aspiring Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得我谈论的内容有用，请考虑看看《临床心理学家集体》和《有抱负的心理学家集体》这两本书。

sentences.en: And if it's your time and you're ready for the next step, please do consider joining the Aspiring Psychologist membership, which gets really wonderful reviews.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得时机成熟，准备好迈出下一步，请考虑加入“有抱负的心理学家”会员计划，它获得了非常好的评价。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for trusting me to help you with your understanding of psychology and developing your career.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你信任我，让我帮助你理解心理学并发展你的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I love creating this podcast for you.
sentences.zh: 我热爱为你制作这个播客。

sentences.en: I will look forward to bringing the next one to you from 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我期待在周一早上6点为你带来下一期节目，

sentences.en: on Monday for the MP3 version and usually the weekend before on YouTube.
sentences.zh: MP3版本通常在周末前发布在YouTube上。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world and stay kind to yourself.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分，请善待自己。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南。

sentences.en: With this podcast, let your side to be on your way.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客，让你的职业之路顺利开启。

sentences.en: Just the Aspiring Psychologist book with Dr. Marianne Duran.
sentences.zh: 只需阅读玛丽安·特伦特博士的《有抱负的心理学家》一书。

sentences.en: What if your professional expertise could earn you money even when you're not working?
sentences.zh: 如果你的专业知识即使在你没工作时也能为你赚钱，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, Clinical Psychologist, and since 2019, I've been building additional income streams through books, online courses and memberships.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直通过书籍、在线课程和会员计划建立额外的收入来源。

sentences.en: And it's made such a difference to my business and my life.
sentences.zh: 这给我的事业和生活带来了巨大的改变。

sentences.en: Tonight at 7 p.m., Sophie Foote is hosting a free Make Money Online Masterclass, exploring how you can turn your existing skills and knowledge into additional income streaMs.
sentences.zh: 今晚7点，苏菲·富特将主持一场免费的“在线赚钱大师班”，探讨如何将你现有的技能和知识转化为额外的收入来源。

sentences.en: And I'd love more psychologists and mental health professionals to join us.
sentences.zh: 我希望更多的心理学家和心理健康专业人士能加入我们。

sentences.en: I'll be there too, supporting a lovely community of fellow psychologists, exploring what's possible beyond one-to-one work.
sentences.zh: 我也会在那里，支持一个可爱的心理学家同行社区，探索一对一工作之外的可能性。

sentences.en: Replays are available if you can't join live.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法参加直播，可以观看回放。

sentences.en: Click the link with this pre-roll or reach out to me on socials to grab your free place.
sentences.zh: 点击此预告片中的链接，或在社交媒体上联系我，获取你的免费名额。

sentences.en: Because you can serve others and deserve financial freedom too.
sentences.zh: 因为你既可以服务他人，也理应获得财务自由。
